option.name: --activate
tip: Auto-activate LVs in a VG when the PVs scanned have completed the VG.

option.name: --allpvs
tip: Show information about PVs outside the devices file.

option.name: --autoactivation
tip: Specify if autoactivation is being used from an event.

option.name: --cache
tip: Scan one or more devices and record that they are online.

option.name: --checkcomplete
tip: Check if all the devices used by a VG or LV are present, and print "complete" or "incomplete" for each listed VG or LV.

option.name: --commandprofile
tip: The command profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --config
tip: Config settings for the command.

option.name: --debug
tip: Set debug level.

option.name: --devices
tip: Restricts the devices that are visible and accessible to the command.

option.name: --devicesfile
tip: A file listing devices that LVM should use.

option.name: --driverloaded
tip: If set to no, the command will not attempt to use device-mapper.

option.name: --exported
tip: Only show PVs belonging to exported VGs.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help text.

option.name: --ignorelockingfailure
tip: Allows a command to continue with read-only metadata operations after locking failures.

option.name: --journal
tip: Record information in the systemd journal.

option.name: --listlvs
tip: Print a list of LVs that use the device.

option.name: --listvg
tip: Print the VG that uses the device.

option.name: --lockopt
tip: Used to pass options for special cases to lvmlockd.

option.name: --longhelp
tip: Display long help text.

option.name: --major
tip: The major number of a device.

option.name: --minor
tip: The minor number of a device.

option.name: --nohints
tip: Do not use the hints file to locate devices for PVs.

option.name: --nolocking
tip: Disable locking.

option.name: --noudevsync
tip: Disables udev synchronization.

option.name: --novolumegroup
tip: Only show PVs not belonging to any VG.

option.name: --profile
tip: An alias for --commandprofile or --metadataprofile, depending on the command.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress output and log messages.

option.name: --reportformat
tip: Overrides current output format for reports which is defined globally by the report/output_format setting in lvm.conf(5).

option.name: --short
tip: Short listing format.

option.name: --test
tip: Run in test mode.

option.name: --udevoutput
tip: Command output is modified to be imported from a udev rule.

option.name: --uuid
tip: Show UUIDs in addition to device names.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Set verbose level.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: --vgonline
tip: The first command to see a complete VG will report it uniquely.

option.name: --yes
tip: Do not prompt for confirmation interactively but always assume the answer yes.
